# Booking a Meeting Room

The third floor has two bookable meeting rooms, named Everest and K2, both visible in the
shared calendar system. Book through the calendar app the same way you'd book time with a
colleague; add the room as a resource to your invite.

Everest seats ten and has a video conferencing bar; K2 seats four and is better for quick
huddles. Rooms release automatically if no one badges in within ten minutes of the booked
start time, so a late arrival can lose the room to a walk-in.

Recurring bookings longer than one month are discouraged; use the drop-in desks instead if
you just need a quiet space regularly.
